name: lipophilicity
preregistration_note: Drafted 2026-10-21 before any run on this dataset; only the CSV header was inspected. Noise floor, control and baseline come from the cited literature; cf_threshold follows the fixed rule 5/3 x noise floor rounded to 0.1 (ESOL's ratio).

source.citation: AstraZeneca logD7.4 deposition in ChEMBL, distributed with MoleculeNet (Wu et al. 2018)

noise_floor_source: Andres et al. 2015, Eur. J. Pharm. Sci., PMID 25968358: shake-flask logD7.4 values 'show a standard deviation lower than 0.3'.

control.name: calculated lipophilicity
control.rationale: logD is logP corrected for ionisation at the measurement pH, so calculated logP is the first-order predictor; rules should say something beyond it.
control.ref: Scherrer & Howard 1977, J. Med. Chem., PMID 13215

baseline.text: Molecules with calculated LogP above the training median ({value:.2f}) have higher logD7.4.
Molecules containing a carboxylic acid have lower logD7.4 (ionised at pH 7.4).
Molecules containing a basic aliphatic amine have lower logD7.4 (protonated at pH 7.4).
Molecules with two or more hydrogen-bond donors have lower logD7.4.
baseline.ref: textbook (H-bond donors favour water over octanol)
